title: cynanchica lilaciflora subsp. coa
intro: Cynanchica lilaciflora subsp. coa, commonly known as "Coa Vine" or "Cynanchum coa," is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchica lilaciflora subsp. coa include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties, which may help alleviate pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
